# USDA total outlays by fiscal year (millions of dollars), [redacted]-1998
# from Treasury Bulletin FFO-3 (On-budget and off-budget outlays by agency)
# Best-known historical values for Department of Agriculture total outlays:
data = {
    [redacted]: 46012,
    1991: 54110,
    1992: 56416,
    1993: 63152,
    1994: 60790,
    1995: 56668,
    1996: 54353,
    1997: 52512,
    1998: 53929,
}

xs = [year - [redacted] for year in sorted(data)]
ys = [data[year] for year in sorted(data)]

n = len(xs)
mean_x = sum(xs) / n
mean_y = sum(ys) / n

slope = sum((x - mean_x) * (y - mean_y) for x, y in zip(xs, ys)) / \
        sum((x - mean_x) ** 2 for x in xs)
intercept = mean_y - slope * mean_x

x_pred = 1999 - [redacted]
pred = slope * x_pred + intercept

print([round(slope, 2), round(intercept), round(pred)])
